nodes.label: the breached cellar wall
nodes.description: The wall Glowkindle's excavation crew broke through while expanding the fermentation cellar -- the structural opening that put the crew in the giant rats' path.

nodes.label: the giant statue foot
nodes.description: An enormous boulder-like shape along the river trail that resolves, on approach, into what looks like the foot of a once-giant statue -- or, just as plausibly, an oversized joke by whichever sculptor made it. The source text plays up this ambiguity rather than settling it; see deferred:statue-foot-boulder-ambiguity.

beats.title: Arrival at Stone Bridge
beats.summary: The merchant-guard party of six arrives outside the town of Stone Bridge.

beats.title: The pub and Glowkindle's job
beats.summary: At The River's Edge Pub, Grishna shares directions and the party learns of Glowkindle's rat-clearing job on the town job board.

beats.title: Trail to the brewery past the statue foot
beats.summary: Following Grishna's directions, the party hikes upriver past the giant statue foot to the Wizard's Tower Brewing Company.

beats.title: The rat-cellar fight
beats.summary: Glowkindle hires the party to clear giant rats from the fermentation cellar; the fight is harder than expected and a mysterious cat owl is tossed in to help.

beats.title: Tower interior and magma-spider cliffhanger
beats.summary: After the fight, the party explores tiled halls and broken alchemy tools before Karsemine makes eye contact with a flaming magma-infused spider.

deferred_items.label: Stone Bridge town vs the Stone Bridge span
deferred_items.reason: Stone Bridge names both the town and the river crossing; these must remain distinct nodes and must not merge.
deferred_items.suggested_next_step: Keep town (node:stone-bridge-town) and span (node:stone-bridge-span) separate in extraction and vocabulary layers; verify do-not-merge probes in ablation runs.

deferred_items.label: Brewing company vs physical tower cross-class
deferred_items.reason: The Wizard's Tower Brewing Co organization and the shatter mage's tower location refer to overlapping site concepts with different node types.
deferred_items.suggested_next_step: Preserve cross-class separation between node:wizards-tower-brewing-co (organization) and node:wizards-tower (location) in extraction and vocabulary ablation.

deferred_items.label: Is the giant foot a real ruined statue, or an oversized sculptor's joke?
deferred_items.reason: Source text explicitly frames this as unresolved ("probably the former but who really knows with art anyway"). Preserve the ambiguity rather than flattening it into a settled fact.
deferred_items.suggested_next_step: If a later session resolves the statue's true origin, update here rather than silently retconning the landmark.
